name: setfsgid32
description: The setfsgid32() system call sets the filesystem group ID of the calling process to the specified value, which is used for permissions checks when accessing filesystem objects. It succeeds only if the caller is the superuser or if the value matches the caller's real group ID, effective group ID, saved set-group-ID, or current filesystem group ID.

parameters.name: fsgid
parameters.description: The new filesystem group ID to set

return_value.success: Returns the previous filesystem group ID
return_value.failure: Returns the previous filesystem group ID (no distinction between success and failure)

errors.description: When the argument cannot be passed to the kernel without integer truncation

bugs: No error indications are returned, making it impossible to determine if the call succeeded or failed; for example, EPERM should be returned on failure due to insufficient capabilities, but it is not.
